issues.description: Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat registered as KnnVectorsFormat SPI but extends FlatVectorsFormat
issues.detail: The META-INF services file registers Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat under org.apache.lucene.codecs.KnnVectorsFormat, but the class extends FlatVectorsFormat, not KnnVectorsFormat. SPI loading will fail with ClassCastException at startup when the service iterator tries to instantiate it as a KnnVectorsFormat.

issues.description: module-info also provides Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat as KnnVectorsFormat
issues.detail: module-info.java adds Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat to the `provides org.apache.lucene.codecs.KnnVectorsFormat with ...` clause, but the class is a FlatVectorsFormat. The module system will reject this at resolution time, breaking the backward-codecs module load.

issues.description: Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat no longer @Deprecated despite being legacy read-only
issues.detail: The class lost its @Deprecated annotation during the move, yet it is documented as legacy and throws UnsupportedOperationException on write. Removing @Deprecated means downstream users won't see compiler warnings when constructing the old format, even though it is now strictly read-only.

issues.description: Public NAME constants downgraded to package-private may break external integrations
issues.detail: Both Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat.NAME and Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat.NAME (plus QUANTIZED_VECTOR_COMPONENT and calculateDefaultConfidenceInterval) changed from public to package-private. Any external codec, test, or tool referencing these names by constant will fail to compile. For a backward-codecs move this breaks the compatibility contract these symbols previously carried.

issues.description: Dropped numMergeWorkers/mergeExec silently changes read-side merge behavior contract
issues.detail: The constructor still accepts numMergeWorkers and mergeExec, validates them, but no longer stores them. Even though fieldsWriter now throws, the RW subclass Lucene99RWV1HnswScalarQuantizationVectorsFormat constructs a writer with hardcoded `1, null` instead of the passed values, so tests exercising parallel merge no longer test parallel merge paths.

issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT duplicated rather than referenced from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat
issues.detail: A new package-private constant DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT = 16 was added to Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat, duplicating the value previously imported from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat. If the core constant ever changes, the legacy reader/writer will silently diverge. Prefer referencing the original constant via its public accessor.

review.summary: This PR moves the Lucene99 scalar quantized vector formats from core to backward-codecs and makes them read-only. The most serious concerns are SPI/module-info registration mismatches: Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat extends FlatVectorsFormat but is registered as a KnnVectorsFormat service in both META-INF and module-info, which will fail at load time. Secondary issues include loss of the @Deprecated annotation, breaking visibility changes on previously public NAME constants, and a test RW subclass that hardcodes merge parameters rather than threading them through.
